title: Mimetic gravity in the extended objects framework
summary: Starting from the most general second-order in derivatives theories describing extended objects of arbitrary dimension evolving geodetically in a codimension-one flat ambient space-time, we determine the subset of models yielding second-order equations of motion, forming an intriguing theory known as Lovelock-type brane gravity (LBG).
